## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it belongs in Premium Kanban.

## Data-safety impact

Explain any Markdown, frontmatter, `.base`, creation, rename, or deletion behavior. Write “None” if
the change is read-only.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:interaction` when interaction behavior changed
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Tested with synthetic or redacted vault data

## Visual evidence

Add screenshots or a short recording for user-interface changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept the change focused and within the current product scope.
- [ ] I used Obsidian public APIs or documented why that was not possible.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where behavior changed.
- [ ] I included no private vault content, credentials, personal links, or identifying screenshots.
- [ ] Disabling the plugin leaves Markdown task data usable.
